name: Kurir Kampung
tagline: Neighbourhood couriers by motorbike and small van.
about: A cooperative of local drivers who pick up from small shops and deliver within South Jakarta.
payment: Cash to the driver at pickup.

items.name: Motorbike, same district
items.description: One pickup and one drop-off in the same district. Up to 20 kg or 40 food boxes.

items.name: Motorbike, across districts
items.description: One pickup and one drop-off in different districts. Up to 20 kg or 40 food boxes.

items.name: Small van
items.description: Up to 300 kg or 200 food boxes, with a helper to carry.

items.name: Extra pickup stop
items.description: Add one more pickup to a trip, such as collecting from two shops.

policies: Give the pickup and drop-off addresses in the order notes on our page.
Waiting longer than 15 minutes at a pickup costs Rp5.000 per 15 minutes, paid to the driver.
